archive_note: Classifier v1.0.0-pilot plus Hybrid A. A Method C linear segment that passes Rule 3 is a plateau when S = |slope| * omega_span is at most 1e-4. No merging. The ODE was not rerun.

alpha.source: Stage 2C selected cell, equivalent to original Method C at tau=1. Stage 2C status remains Calibration inconclusive.
alpha.reason_for_use: User adopted this pair for the first full pilot classification together with the decision rules below.

beta.source: Same Stage 2C cell. beta = tau when tau = 1.

minimum_segment_length.reason_for_use: Existing Method C constraint. Not a physical plateau size.

noise_estimation.value: sigma_hat = max(1.4826 * MAD(second difference of rho) / sqrt(6), 1e-12)
noise_estimation.reason_for_use: Required by the Method C objective. Not replaced.

rule_1_windows.temporal_review_flag: Set when the three window states differ, or when the counts of validated nonzero plateaus differ.

rule_2_candidates.nonzero_plateau_candidates: A Method C constant segment that passes Rule 3, or a Method C linear segment that passes Rule 3 and S = |slope| * omega_span <= tau_S.
rule_2_candidates.linear_segments: Eligible when Rule 3 holds and the trend cap holds. No second segmentation and no merge.
rule_2_candidates.near_zero: Detected from abs(rho) < 0.001, independent of Method C.
rule_2_candidates.global_locking_exception: Rule 7 can assign Locking when Method C returns only linear segments.

rule_3_valid_plateau.source: User specification. The 732-profile constant-segment histograms had no empty gap selecting these numbers.
rule_3_valid_plateau.relative_omega_span_definition: (max omega in the segment - min omega in the segment) / (max omega - min omega) on the frequency-sorted profile
rule_3_valid_plateau.nonzero_level_definition: A Rule 3 segment counts toward Partial Locking only when abs(mean rho) >= 0.001. Near-zero levels stay with the near-zero rules.

rule_4_near_zero_tolerance.source: User choice. On this pilot it labels the same oscillators as any tolerance in (0.001, 0.00622].

rule_6_partial_death.source: User choice. On this pilot any integer from 12 through 26 selects the same profiles.

rule_7_locking.definition: max(rho) - min(rho) <= 0.01 on the whole frequency-sorted profile
rule_7_locking.source: User choice. On this pilot any threshold in [0.000851, 0.01253) selects the same non-death profiles.

hybrid_a.definition: S = abs(ordinary-least-squares slope of rho on omega) * (omega_end - omega_start)
hybrid_a.source: Provisional operating value chosen between 1e-4 and 5e-4 after the incremental-error recalibration. It is the smaller cap. It is not an identified optimum.

partial_locking_boundary.rule: At least one validated plateau with abs(mean rho) >= 0.001. Otherwise Incoherence, after the higher-priority states.
partial_locking_boundary.source: No empty gap in plateau coverage above the smallest positive coverage 0.024. Count >= 1 matches coverage > 0 on this pilot.

locked_fraction_definition: 1 when the W3 state is Locking. Otherwise the fraction of oscillators covered by validated nonzero plateaus.
